title: Best rectangle for a fixed perimeter
statement:
A rectangle has perimeter $4([$a])$ m. Find its maximum area in square meters.

[__________]{a}
hints: If one side is $x$, the other is $2a-x$.
Write the area as a downward-opening quadratic.
Check the vertex is in the feasible interval.
solution: $A=x(2[$a]-x)$ is maximized at $x=[$a]$ on $[0,2[$a]]$. The area is $[$a]^2$.

feedback.message: Check the vertex is in the feasible interval.
